items.text: To help youth to be aware and use the available social and economic opportunities around them.
To persuade and equip youth in being aware of their inner strength, courage and potentials, thus knowing the importance of engaging on development activities.
To support Youth and the community’s awareness and understanding on the positive, efficient, safe and productive use of resources

To persuade and guide youth to cooperate and share among themselves different social economic issues related to the whole agenda of helping them to improve their lives. This will result community development
To accomplish the idea of “Vijana kujiwezesha, kuwezeshana na kuwezeshwa” economically.
